Priya (SRE): Posted NovaCorp dedicated postmortem (VPC peering flap + on-prem route leak). Short: peering race + misapplied route-map led to tenant crossover. Link in docs.

inc-bot: Postmortem created: /incidents/1869997777-novacorp-dedicated-isolation.md :rotating_light:

Evan (Platform): paste owners & due dates so I can create infra tickets.

Priya (SRE): Actions:
1) Peering health daemon (control+tcp checks) 1 owner: Evan (Platform) 1 due: 2026-06-08
2) On-prem policy detection tests 1 owner: Marta (Support) 1 due: 2026-06-15
3) Dedicated onboarding isolation checklist (passive default) 1 owner: Marta (Support) 1 due: 2026-06-01
4) Customer comms + NOC one-pager 1 owner: Owen (CS) 1 due: 2026-05-30

Marta (Support): verification script will be passive-by-default; active capture opt-in. ETA 4 days.

Evan (Platform): I'll open INF-5133 for the probe and link PR when ready. Plan: daemonset on nodes running tcp handshake to peer IPs from node netns.

Priya (SRE): Recurring pattern: fourth peering-related isolation in 10 months. Proposing monthly "isolation trend" review. Owner: Priya. Start 2026-06-05.

Owen (CS): I'll draft comms and send to legal today (~48h). Can we provide a short checklist customers can run?

Priya (SRE): Yes — include passive commands and opt-in steps for active checks. Update postmortem with ticket/PR links and we'll reconvene 2 weeks after to close items.

All: :thumbsup:
